# JustMoveHere

> New life, new home. South Florida.

JustMoveHere.com is a relocation guide to South Florida, run by Oppenheim Realty. It helps people moving to the Fort Lauderdale area discover neighborhoods, things to do, places to eat, events, hotels, date nights, and free activities, and connect with a local broker about buying or renting a home.

## Contact

## New Construction

The New Construction section lists 22 new condominium projects: 8 in Pompano Beach and 14 in Fort Lauderdale, including Ombelle, The Ritz-Carlton Residences Pompano Beach, 3000 Waterside, Andare Residences by Pininfarina, The St. Regis Resort and Residences Bahia Mar, and Sixth&Rio. Six projects include detailed developer information (pricing, residences, delivery, amenities, and sales contacts).
